name: Nature Spirit Base
notes: Chassis for Nature Spirits: place-bound guardian beings tied to a specific natural seat (grove, spring, hill, marsh, etc.). Provides identity Tags and Traits. Domain / Motivation / Loadout / Quirk ChangeSets layer on top to specialise the spirit.

name: Beast Base
notes: Chassis for Beasts: dangerous natural animals (wolves, bears, boars, great cats, etc.) driven by hunger, fear, territory, or pack instinct. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Pack-Hunter / Brute-Predator / Ambush-Hunter / Scavenger ChangeSets layer on top to specialise.

name: Hidden Folk Base
notes: Chassis for Hidden Folk: elder parallel people occupying the land beside humanity, dangerous through glamour, influence, and folklore-law rather than violence. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Hill / Hearth / Wood / Water ChangeSets layer on top to specialise.

name: Undead Base
notes: Chassis for Undead: beings that failed to pass out of the world in death (revenants, draugr, ghosts, hauntings, fetches, etc.). Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Restless / Ghost / Unquiet / Living-Dead / Haunting / Fetch ChangeSets layer on top to specialise.

name: The Unseen Base
notes: Chassis for The Unseen: singular elder powers of the Hidden Folk civilization (Jinn, Lady of the Lake, Sidhe nobles, Erlking, Frau Holle, Wild Hunt leaders). Provides identity Tags and Traits plus four default powers. Courtly / Water Sovereign / Winter Matron / Hunt Master / Smokeless Fire ChangeSets layer on top.

name: Unnatural Base
notes: Chassis for Unnaturals: outsider entities (devils, demons, angels, soul-drinkers, possessors, messengers) from another existence brought into the world by summoning, breach, invitation, or unlawful passage. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Angelic / Infernal / Demonic / Tempter / Possessor / Familiar / Soul Drinker / Messenger / Commander ChangeSets layer on top.

name: Construct Base
notes: Chassis for Constructs: made beings (golems, homunculi, animated guardians, laboratory things, crafted servitors) given force, motion, and purpose by human or nonhuman craft. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Golem / Homunculus / Brazen Head / Wax Servitor Domain ChangeSets layer on top.

name: Colossus Base
notes: Chassis for Colossi: rare immense beings (dragons, kraken, leviathans) defined by overwhelming scale, force, dormancy, hunger, and catastrophic presence. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Dragon / Sea Colossus / Abyssal / Ancient Cunning ChangeSets layer on top.

name: Zone Base
notes: Chassis for Zone creatures: eerie stalking beings tied to warped pockets of reality, known more by signs and partial glimpses than clear sight. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Manifestation / Echo Person / Zone Predator / Warped Servitor / Boundary Haunter ChangeSets layer on top.

name: People Base
notes: Chassis for People: human opposition built as monster archetypes (guards, commoners, men-at-arms, knights, raiders) rather than full PC sheets. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Commoner / Guard / Raider / Man-at-Arms / Knight ChangeSets layer on top.
